g.text: Applying an Incoming Operation Inside One Document Session Service
handleIncoming(op, clientBaseSeq) -- one document, one instance, strictly sequential
An op that raced N other ops is transformed N times, once per op, in the exact order
those ops landed in the durable log -- never against a summarized view of "everything since".
Only log.append() needs real atomicity; the log store provides it natively (monotonic offset).
